rule: A gate is complete only when its implementation and required behavioral evidence exist. Contract fixtures never count as live provider, real inference or physical-device acceptance.

gates.requirement: Integrate HarmonyOS handoff without losing saved login or composer fixes
gates.evidence: Fast-forward to fa8c54ad; native acceptance pending

gates.requirement: Typed Computer API, one hub attachment, lifecycle and reconnect independence
gates.evidence: tests/domain.test.ts and tests/transport.test.ts

gates.requirement: Single owners, separate invitations, dual membership creation, hub-first retention
gates.evidence: 32 policy combinations plus browser live changes

gates.requirement: Hub-local accounts and identity bindings; optional shared authority only when explicitly configured
gates.evidence: Independent Hub account/database/signing-key ownership is exercised by isolated Hub and browser checks. Explicit linking and provider/PKCE fixtures cover Hub-local identities; the optional shared-authority coordinator remains compatible but is not an independent-Hub dependency. Live provider delivery remains separate.

gates.requirement: Feishu, WeChat, email and phone sign-in on actual integrations
Independent hubs, exact token audience, scoped discovery, fail-closed policy decisions
gates.evidence: Independent Hub processes with separate accounts, databases and signing keys; 5 distributed browser checkpoints; exact audience isolation and fail-closed policy outage tests. Shared-authority compatibility tests are separate from this independent-Hub evidence.

gates.requirement: Owner-bound single-use enrollment and transfer fencing within the configured authority
gates.evidence: Owner-bound single-use enrollment and transfer fencing verified for the existing shared-authority compatibility mode; two browser users issue target-owner admission and move a Computer. Reused/stale admissions and old Computer credentials are rejected. Short enrollment codes are 8 characters and expire after 15 minutes; tests cover exact expiry, single-use, renewal invalidation, typing normalization, legacy-token compatibility and redemption attempt limits. Live browser/CLI attachment and source download passed. This does not establish transfer across independent Hub databases; source detach and destination admission across independent authorities remain pending.

gates.requirement: Bounded streaming uploads, binary downloads, ranges, SSE, cancellation and media paths
gates.evidence: tests/http-mux.test.ts and tests/http-relay.test.ts: credit bounds; 16 blocked streams remain within per-computer memory limits while heartbeats continue; a 17th stream is rejected before dispatch; byte-identical binary/range/ETag/multipart/HLS, gzip decoding, cancellation, feed filtering and revocation. Production deployment load tests remain pending. A 257 MiB+37 byte native file crosses real WebSocket HttpMux with matching SHA-256, ranges, cancellation and bounded credit queues. Concurrent tail request uses a runtime stub. Browser downloads retain the 256 MiB cap; authenticated larger-file/browser acceptance remains open.

gates.requirement: Real isolated CLI continues across hub and client loss; terminal sessions import
gates.evidence: Existing isolated Pi shell and hub-loss recovery checks remain valid. On 2026-10-04, a Computer was created through the deployed browser, attached using the CLI and an 8-character code, and became Online. Both authenticated Codex and Pi (gpt-6.1-sol, ChatGPT OAuth) were created from New session and executed real shell write/read operations. Their streamed replies and generated files were verified through the browser. Claude live authentication, native app acceptance and comprehensive real-provider outage recovery remain pending. Latest separate native browser acceptance passes all nine Pi/Claude saved resume, Codex/Claude import/interrupt, service/tunnel reconnect and untrusted Codex setup checks with installed CLIs and controlled gateways. Full live-provider/commit-boundary faults remain open.

gates.requirement: Files, git, uploads, queues, settings, search, voice and scoped recovery
gates.evidence: Actual browser: imported Pi transcript, Git diff, file read/download/edit, search, queue/edit/authorized dispatch, second real Pi process via New session, normal file-picker upload, separate personal drafts for two users, a live read-only downgrade, and owner-only deletion through the normal confirmation. Deletion denies operators before dispatch and retains catalog entries after unconfirmed local replies. Owner-issued workspace read/write grants now pass two-account actual-Pi browser checks, including inspection, editing, traversal/symlink rejection and immediate revocation. Selective per-agent sharing is separately verified by the agent-sharing gate. Multiple roots, delegated Git/uploads/transcoding, notification implementation, broader lifecycle faults and broader accessibility remain pending. Eight independent-client Chrome voice/settings checks prove Save/Cancel/Escape, key masking/preservation/clear, genuine TTS/ffmpeg HLS playback, opt-out cancellation and browser access-loss cleanup. Controlled tone WAV proves playback, not speech quality; server listener expiry is 45 seconds.

gates.requirement: Explicit direct profile with no automatic fallback and regression coverage
gates.evidence: Explicit direct and relay profiles with isolated credential keys; actual Harmony ApiClient direct login, no fallback and stale-response rejection exercised with mocked OS networking. Complete native/direct regression still pending

gates.requirement: Computer-owned durable queued prompts reauthorize the actor before dispatch and never replay uncertain sends
gates.evidence: Queue restart, attachment fencing, revoked actor, edits during authorization and uncertain-send tests; actual Pi browser queues, edits and sends after the current turn. Visible pause reasons update while the dialog is open. Pending prompts pause without the policy service; a narrow 24-hour permit never authenticates as a user. Terminal-local queue integration remains pending. Latest native broker tests prove post-authorization idle recheck, definite rejection before paste, Enter-before-ACK, serialized sends and uncertainty on native death/input/interrupt during submission. Unified terminal-local ordering and complete hard-kill matrix remain pending.

gates.requirement: Unsent remote drafts remain private to their account and Computer attachment
gates.evidence: Computer-owned private SQLite storage, actor-specific catalog timestamps and tombstones; tests cover restart, account/session/attachment isolation and size bounds. Two actual browser accounts sharing one real Pi session cannot read or overwrite each other’s drafts.

gates.requirement: Recover a completed launch after a lost reply without starting a duplicate process
gates.evidence: Computer commits an uncertainty barrier before launch and saves the result by agent and attachment. Read-only receipt lookup survives restart and rejects duplicate launches. Actual browser recovers an existing Pi agent after a simulated lost central result; local process count stays at two. Late failures cannot erase the recovered result. If the Computer never saved a result, explicit owner inspection/import remains necessary.

gates.requirement: Durable completion outbox, deduplication, access checks and provider delivery
gates.evidence: Binding-scoped durable Computer outbox and hub inbox/ACK, stable IDs, 24-hour TTL, access/session/binding rechecks immediately before dispatch, bounded delivery ledger and scoped unsubscribe. Five notification tests verify restart/replay/revocation/token changes/provider PS256 payload; shared client tests use the actual hub API. Actual Pi completion arrives after a hub outage. Foreground feed excludes unpublished sessions. Physical Harmony delivery, native multi-hub presenter integration and Web Push remain pending.

gates.requirement: Native relay login, context, media, secure credentials, device lifecycle and push
gates.evidence: Actual ApiClient and Workspace execute in behavioral tests with mocked OS boundaries: relay JSON/SSE/binary/media, cancellation, account/hub/computer recovery scopes, bounded SHA-256 draft filenames, notification scope isolation, and unchanged direct filenames. Native login presenter, secure refresh vault, multi-hub push subscriptions, SDK build and physical-device acceptance remain pending.

gates.requirement: Client cannot reach computers; outbound-only relay works under faults and load
gates.evidence: Separate Docker front/back networks with verified TLS: client cannot reach computer private IP; hub can; computer-initiated WSS carries conversation. Fault/load matrix remains pending Latest bounded native load/fault measurements and post-ACK lost-reply/restart nonreplay are recorded in artifacts/native-load-fault-results.json; this does not establish the full fault matrix.

gates.requirement: Versioned OpenAPI, tunnel schemas and shared native conformance fixtures
gates.evidence: Generated v1 OpenAPI and tunnel JSON schemas, shared TypeScript transport/login lifecycle, three executed Harmony behavioral tests. Complete public route schemas and native platform conformance still pending.

gates.requirement: Runtime identities must never attach old permissions or recovery state to a new instance
gates.evidence: Native brokers retain UUID identities through restart, log binding and resume; legacy PID-only relay targets are rejected. Detached PTY sessions survive Computer restart and two sessions in the same cwd bind only their own producer logs.

gates.requirement: iOS/Android and OAR interfaces and adoption gates specified
gates.evidence: Design sections 05 and 07 explicitly stage implementation later

gates.requirement: Owner grants delegated read/write access to the Computer-configured workspace; membership loss removes files independently of transcript retention
gates.evidence: Native TypeScript secure pinned file-descriptor access, CAS, symlink/hardlink and root boundaries verified in Docker; owner-issued workspace read/write grants and immediate revocation checked through the browser. Linux accepted; macOS secure adapter pending.

gates.requirement: Owner invitations addressed to email, verified phone or exact provider identity without requiring linked email
gates.evidence: tests/invitations.test.ts; independent-hub public API checks; mobile Manage access and Accept invitation browser flows with phone and tenant-specific Feishu identities; copied invitation details. Live provider delivery is a separate gate.

gates.requirement: Selective viewer/operator access to concrete agents independently of computer membership, with explicit revocation and no new-agent creation
gates.evidence: tests/agent-sharing.test.ts; independent-hub API verifies private/future agent exclusion, owner-only sharing, workspace/creation boundaries, queued dispatch and notification authorization, stream downgrade and closure. Two-account mobile browser shares, sends, downgrades/revokes via actual Agent access screen.

gates.requirement: Self-contained v2 with TypeScript native PTY/runtime and tests, no Python or original package dependency, explicit component boundaries
gates.evidence: Latest combined Docker production build and 177/177 TypeScript tests, no failures/skips; 46 generic browser checks without errors. Separate installed-CLI lifecycle browser suite passes nine checks and real Chrome voice/settings suite passes eight, with six native media tests. Bounded native load/fault and 257 MiB streaming transport suites pass with scope/remaining limits in work-progress.json. Earlier dated migration/provider/workspace evidence remains historical evidence, not a claim of live inference or complete production readiness. The boundary build guard passes. Linux accepted; macOS secure adapter remains pending.
